I have a permanent back condition and was told by a GP that I don’t need a repeat prescription, just to call when I need the medication. Yet every single time I try, they refuse to issue it and force me into an appointment instead.
The problem is appointments are always booked over a week away, and I work full-time, so I can’t just drop everything to attend. This means I’m left struggling without the only medication that actually helps when my back flares up.
It makes no sense to waste both my time and the doctor’s time with unnecessary appointments when the arrangement has already been agreed. The lack of consistency, the long waits, and the complete disregard for patients’ circumstances is unacceptable.
